text: SEMKIT-075: the spec flags --n and --column clashed with pipeline/commands.py: a one-letter name made -n, and 'column' is a reserved table argument. I added the mark LONG (steps/__init__.py) for --n and let a REPEATED option be named column; existing steps unchanged. Check if you want another way.
note: Accepted: the LONG mark and a repeated option named column are the right way; existing steps unchanged.
